description: Accounts in Judaeo-Arabic mentioning a wide variety of foodstuffs, spices, and other commodities. Dating: 16th-century or later based on the paleography. Some of the items listed include: ḥallūmī cheese, almonds, sulfur, Alexandrian wax, carob, dining plates, soap, silk, pepper, cinnamon, olive oil, among many others. Verso has jottings in Hebrew and Arabic script, some of which comprise honorifics for nomenclature.
description_he: חשבונות בערבית-יהודית, מאוחרים; בגב הדף רישומים בעברית ובכתב ערבי.
